definitions.explanation: A personal thought or judgment about something.
A recommendation or counsel given to someone.

notes:
{意見|いけん} means 'opinion' or 'view.'

Common collocations:
- {意見|いけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧/⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧: to state an opinion
- {意見|いけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to listen to/ask for opinions
- {意見|いけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧/⟦{一致|いっち}→一致：01733_icchi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to agree (opinions match)
- {意見|いけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧/⟦{分|わ}かれる→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧: to disagree
- {意見|いけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exchange opinions

Similar words:
- {意見|いけん} vs. ⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧: {意見|いけん} is more formal/official; ⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧ is more casual/personal thinking
- {意見|いけん} vs. ⟦{感想|かんそう}→感想：00450_kansou⟧: ⟦{感想|かんそう}→感想：00450_kansou⟧ is impression/feeling; {意見|いけん} is thought/judgment
